title: Stories and dashboards
explain: Garbage models produce executive chaos. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Stories and dashboards" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Stories and dashboards, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Stories and dashboards without a failure story
howToApply: Use Stories and dashboards explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Stories and dashboards” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Stories → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Stories and dashboards” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Stories and dashboards” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Finance and Sales disagree on “revenue” — Stories and dashboards forces one productized definition.
